# Mainstream Green Energy Solutions

> Mainstream Green Energy Solutions is a Nigerian solar energy company in Ogun State that designs, installs, and maintains solar power systems for homes and businesses.

Mainstream Green Energy Solutions helps Nigerian homeowners and businesses reduce fuel and generator costs, enjoy uninterrupted electricity, and receive long-term support after installation. Head office: 214 Ibadan road, beside Gatelink filling station, express, Imowo 120101, Ogun State, Nigeria. Phone: +234 706 667 0673. Email: ask@mainstreamgreenenergy.com.ng. Hours: Mon-Sat 8am-6pm, Sunday closed.

## Services
- Solar panel sales & installation
- Commercial solar solutions
- Residential solar systems
- Battery backup & inverters
- Energy audits & consultation
- Maintenance & performance monitoring

## Key facts
- 300+ happy clients
- 23+ engineers
- 540+ projects completed
- 4.8 average client rating
- Areas served: Ogun State, Lagos, Ibadan, and wider Nigeria
